FunctionInput_lessonly_restoreuser.description: The archived user whose archive state should be reversed.

archivedAt.description: Null confirms the returned user is not archived.

archivedByUserId.description: Provider-returned archiver reference; normally null after restore, omitted if unavailable.

FunctionOutput_lessonly_restoreuser.description: The restored user identity and provider-confirmed nonarchived state.

tags.instructions: Use `get-user` or `list-users` to obtain and inspect an archived user's ID. This reverses the archive state, not deletion. Use `archive-user` for the opposite transition. Effects on assignments, associations, and notifications beyond the archive state are not established.

functions.name: update-group
functions.description: Partially modify a group's name and explicitly add or remove member and manager associations without replacing unrelated membership. Availability is limited on transitioning accounts.

name.description: New group name; omitted leaves it unchanged. Empty and null names are not accepted.

memberChanges.description: Explicit member association changes; users not listed remain unchanged.

action.description: Add the association or remove only that association; never deletes the user.

userId.description: Existing user whose association is changed.

items.description: One explicit user association change.

managerChanges.description: Explicit manager association changes; users not listed remain unchanged.

action.description: Add the association or remove only that association; never deletes the user.

userId.description: Existing user whose association is changed.

items.description: One explicit user association change.

FunctionInput_lessonly_updategroup.description: Partially update a group with at least one supplied change.

managerChanges.description: Explicit manager association changes; users not listed remain unchanged.

memberChanges.description: Explicit member association changes; users not listed remain unchanged.

name.description: New group name; omitted leaves it unchanged. Empty and null names are not accepted.
Group name returned after the update.

items.description: Returned member identifier.

memberIds.description: Member IDs returned after the update, not per-change success indicators.

archivedAt.description: Archive instant in UTC or null if unarchived.

items.description: Returned manager identifier.

managerIds.description: Manager IDs returned after the update, independent of membership.

archivedByUserId.description: Archiving user's identifier or null when unspecified.

FunctionOutput_lessonly_updategroup.description: The group state returned by Lessonly after the update.

tags.instructions: Get groupId and existing associations from `get-group` or `list-groups`. Supply only the changes needed; omission leaves a field alone. Association changes add or remove only the listed users, never delete users. Use `create-group` for a new group and `archive-group` for lifecycle changes. Group writes may be unavailable on transitioning accounts.

functions.name: update-lesson
functions.description: Partially modify a lesson's title, retake score setting or public visibility. Lesson writes may be unavailable during transition to Seismic.

title.description: Replacement title; omission preserves it. Null and empty text are not accepted.

retakeScore.description: Positive retake score setting; omission preserves it. No undocumented percentage ceiling is imposed.

isPublic.description: Whether the lesson should be public; omission preserves current visibility.

FunctionInput_lessonly_updatelesson.description: A lesson identifier and at least one setting to change.

title.description: Lesson title returned after the update.

FunctionOutput_lessonly_updatelesson.description: The lesson settings returned after the update.

tags.instructions: Obtain lessonId from `list-lessons` or `get-lesson`. Supply only fields to change; making a lesson public changes its visibility. Use `assign-lesson` for learner assignments and `archive-lesson` for lifecycle changes. On an uncertain result, inspect `get-lesson` before repeating.

functions.name: update-user
functions.description: Partially update a user's profile, role, and selected custom-field values while preserving omitted attributes. User-write availability may be restricted during the Seismic transition.

userId.description: Identifier of the user to modify.

name.description: Replacement full name, subject to user-name restrictions.

role.description: Replacement standard role; do not combine with roleId.

locale.description: Replacement interface language; omission preserves the current language.

roleId.description: Replacement existing role identifier; alternative to role.

hireDate.description: Replacement hire calendar date. Clearing this date is not offered without established provider semantics.

jobTitle.description: Replacement job title; empty text requests a clear.

location.description: Replacement location; empty text requests a clear.

department.description: Replacement department; empty text requests a clear.

externalId.description: Replacement external identifier; empty text requests a clear.

managerName.description: Replacement manager display name; empty text requests a clear.

businessUnit.description: Replacement business unit; empty text requests a clear.

customFields.description: Selected custom-field values to add or update; empty array makes no custom-field changes, not a deletion.

name.description: Custom-field name; unknown names create definitions.

value.description: New text value; empty text clears the value but does not remove its definition.

items.description: One custom-field value selected by definition identifier or name.

changes.description: Partial profile changes; omitted properties are preserved and null is rejected.

FunctionInput_lessonly_updateuser.description: Identify an existing user and supply only the profile attributes or custom-field values to change.

hireDate.description: Saved hire calendar date, or null when unset.

jobTitle.description: Saved job title; null and empty text remain distinct.

location.description: Saved location; null and empty text remain distinct.

department.description: Saved department; null and empty text remain distinct.

externalId.description: Saved external identifier; null and empty text remain distinct.

businessUnit.description: Saved business unit; null and empty text remain distinct.

customFields.description: Custom-field values returned by the update.

items.description: A stored custom-field value returned by the provider.

FunctionOutput_lessonly_updateuser.description: Saved user profile returned by Lessonly, preserving absent, null, and empty values.

tags.instructions: Use an ID from `list-users` or `get-user`. Supply only attributes to change. Empty text clears supported text attributes; null is not accepted. Custom fields are updated individually, not replaced as a collection, and unknown names create definitions. Use the group-association tools for groups and `archive-user` or `restore-user` for lifecycle changes.
